summary_md: **Yuxuan Li ([@_LiYuXuan_](https://x.com/_LiYuXuan_/status/2115997115587391698))** open-sources **ForgeKernel** after a nearly day-long live recursive self-improvement run that wrote 31 versions of DeepSeek V4.1 FlashMLA prefill from scratch without seeing official code, passing the baseline at version 13 within 10 hours and reaching 109.8% efficiency by hour 23 ([live page](https://openbmb.cn/forgekernel/), [OpenBMB/ForgeKernel](https://github.com/OpenBMB/ForgeKernel)).
